data.narrative:
Tytan Technologies is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Balazs Nagy and Batuhan Yumurtaci that has raised €30M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion, which serve as anchors for sector benchmarking.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €30M raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding $60M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comparable set produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling) represented by companies including Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), and Harmattan AI ($1.4B).

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $51M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $530M. The wide spread reflects inherent stage and maturity dispersion within the Defense & Security peer set. Key uncertainties include product commercialization velocity, customer concentration risk, and export control implications specific to the sector. Refinement would benefit from revenue run-rate data and customer pipeline visibility.
